title: Sibling memory root validation skips realpath boundary checks
description: Sibling memory validation only compares lexical dirname(projectRoot) and dirname(memoryRoot), then skips assertRealPathInside because sibling roots are outside the project. A sibling path that is itself a symlink can redirect setup/vault/gitignore writes outside the intended sibling boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing sibling memory roots must realpath to the same real parent as the selected project root.
Missing sibling roots validate the deepest existing ancestor so symlink escapes cannot be created through setup.
Regression tests cover sibling memory symlink escapes and valid sibling memory roots.
